name: Frozen Greater Frostflow · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.65-block radius for 18 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Light push
• Cold 216: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Cold 216: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
